fitted_on: 2026-10-19, the shisa-ai/shisa-de-2.1 release candidate before upload: the mean of eleven pool v11 LoRA updates (v11cr seeds 1-8, 10, 13, 42; adapter sha256 a03c54d9eb1a37e0...) merged into google/gemma-4-26B-A4B-it in bfloat16, with shisa-ai/shisa-de-2's config, chat templates and tokenizer, on a local vLLM 0.30.0 server: TRITON_ATTN (chosen by default), one RTX PRO 6000, max_model_len 262144, 64 concurrent requests, read through this client at de2-codebook-v1. 19,597 questions from 59 suites of research-jev-universal-classifiers evals/suites (reversed-order copies excluded), every question with no time cap. Each question was read once (`direct`) and twice (`repeat2`); the 1,396 below the 0.7 gate with at most 26 options were sent through the thinking read, and 1,298 thought. Fit: weighted NLL grid 0.5-32.0 step 0.01, every suite given equal weight, noul and choice separately, score distributions under the choice fit. `direct` and `repeat2` were fitted on one half of the groups and measured on the other. `think` is one temperature for both types fitted on all 1,298 rows (1,081 choice, 217 noul), measured by 5-fold cross-validation. `temperatures` repeats the `repeat2` entry; `reads` is what the client applies.

test_ece.split: held-out half of the groups; 5-fold cross-validation for think

source: scripts/calibrate_de2_collect.py (time cap removed for this run) and scripts/calibrate_de2_fit.py in this repository; rows and the fit report kept outside it at /data/de2/calibration-avg-v11cr-n11-20261019 (reads.jsonl sha256 6a601dbd3f94d4d7..., thoughts.jsonl sha256 d40720030663b937...); comparison with the DE-2 record in research-jev-universal-classifiers evals/reports/de21-rc-calibration-v1.json
note: Fitted on the release candidate's merged weights before upload; the published checkpoint is expected to be these weights. DE-2's temperatures over-correct this checkpoint (read-twice noul ECE 0.048 on the same held-out half, against 0.040 raw and 0.023 with this fit). Known limits: the suites are evaluation suites whose overlap with the training pool was not checked; no image questions; one serving shape; 936 of the 1,298 thoughts were cut by the 1,024-token budget, and the think fit still leaves a cross-validated ECE of 0.086. The gate reads raw probabilities and is unaffected. Re-fit before relying on these numbers for a threshold on another serving shape.
